ops.title: A # ccx:raw comment never records a tooling refusal (v12.79.3, #260)
ops.body: Owner ruling: # ccx:raw is the sanctioned escape. tooling.py refusal() now records only from SIGNATURES (cc-slack session, cc-slack no_watch, github-quota on failed ccx/gh/stack-enqueue). Raw-fallback source deleted in #260 (8427822e), tagged v12.79.3, PyPI release green. The tooling_nudge LLM judge has no raw-comment detector either; its PROMPT still lists a raw fallback as fire-worthy context.
